name: Opener
description: A tool for opening cases, capsules or collections on the accounts you choose: Practice run shows what it would do, Open now buys a set amount (or what the spare cash covers, or uses what is in stock), opens it all and keeps or sells the drops. Keeps stats of every open: per case and per account, by day, with the best drop.

queue.label: Case queue
queue.help: Opened in order, top to bottom: a batch of each, then the next.

amount.label: How many
amount.help: Each batch: bought and opened (Buy a set amount), the most to buy with spare cash, or the most to open from stock.

queueRounds.label: Rounds (times through the queue per Open now)

queueForever.label: Loop forever
queueForever.help: Goes round the queue again and again until you press Stop. It also stops once a whole round opens nothing (no cash or stock left).

options.label: From stock
options.help: Opens only what the accounts already have. Buys nothing.

options.label: Buy a set amount
options.help: Buys this many on each account, then opens them.

options.label: Stock first, then buy
options.help: Opens what each account has in stock first, then buys this many and opens those.

options.label: Buy with spare cash
options.help: Spends the cash above what you keep, then opens it all.

buyAmount.label: Cases to buy on each account
buyAmount.help: Short on cash: buys what it can. With Stock first, bought once the stock is open.

keepMoney.label: Keep cash ($, never spend below this)

spendPerRun.label: Most to spend per Open now ($, 0 = no limit)

useTickets.label: Use event tickets
useTickets.help: During an event, open with event tickets: one ticket per case opened. An account that runs out of tickets, or that the site won't let use them (no event on), stops.

buyTickets.label: Buy tickets
buyTickets.help: Buy one ticket ($0.50) for each case it's about to open that has no ticket yet. Counts against Keep cash and Most to spend.

ticketBuyN.label: Tickets per account
ticketBuyN.help: For the Event tickets buttons: buy this many on each account, or top each up to this many.

sets.label: Sets
sets.help: A set opens something else on its own accounts: one item, or a queue of cases of its own. Accounts on a set open that even when they are not ticked under Which accounts; everyone else opens what step 1 says.

queue.label: Case queue
queue.help: Opened in order, top to bottom: a batch of each, then the next. How many: bought and opened (Buy a set amount), the most to buy with spare cash, or the most to open from stock.

forever.label: Loop forever
forever.help: Goes round the queue until you press Stop, or until a whole round opens nothing.

buyAmount.label: Cases to buy on each (a set amount)

spendPerRun.label: Most to spend per Open now ($, spare cash)

options.label: Sell for cash
options.help: Each drop is sold for cash as it lands.

options.label: Sell for tokens
options.help: Each drop is sold for tokens as it lands.

options.label: Keep
options.help: Nothing is sold; drops stay in the inventory.

keepOver.label: Sell drops worth under ($, 0 = sell all)

lanes.label: Accounts opening at once
lanes.help: At most 3 per IP: the site gets touchy from 4 at once on one connection. Above 3 needs accounts on proxies (Proxies plugin).

exclusive.label: Pause other plugins on these accounts until it's done (clicking goes on)

favSet.label: Set auto-favourite from here
favSet.help: Off: each account keeps the favourite rules set on the site. On: these rules go to every account before it opens. Favourited drops are never sold.

favLow.label: Favourite low floats
favLow.help: Floats under the number below, e.g. 0.0000001.

favHigh.label: Favourite high floats
favHigh.help: Floats over the number below, e.g. 0.99999.

customFloats.label: Custom floats
customFloats.help: Digits and one dot, up to 20 characters, at most 10.

favPatterns.label: Favourite patterns, gems and tiers
favPatterns.help: Named patterns, gems and tier drops, minus any you list below.

patternBlacklist.label: Never favourite these patterns
patternBlacklist.help: Pattern names as the site writes them.

boostCount.label: Keep an open-count boost running
boostCount.help: More cases per open: the biggest one in stock first.

boostMult.label: Keep a multiplier boost running
boostMult.help: +1 open multiplier (each open costs and opens that much more).

boostCashback.label: Keep case-open cashback running
boostCashback.help: Part of each open's cost back.

boostBuy.label: Buy them with ammo when there are none
boostBuy.help: Buys the one that gives the most per ammo. Ammo only, never real money.

hookMin.label: Only post drops worth at least ($, 0 = all)

sellStallMs.label: Sell queue: give up after this long without progress (ms)

backWaitMs.label: Wait for a paused account this long before stopping (ms, tests)

catalogRetryMs.label: Wait between shop read tries (ms, tests)

catalogMs.label: Read the shop again after this long (ms, tests)
